title: Qualify semantics, leakage and failure recovery
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Every critical adversarial case is detected with valid controls passing; exact evidence/eligibility/split/replay gates hold.
Review coverage and quality measurements satisfy preregistered criteria or explicitly fail/block release.
Source changes and interrupted writes preserve old complete releases and cannot produce false current acceptance.
description: Evaluate the real release against frozen criteria using deterministic gates and independent bounded semantic review.
